name: Vatnajökull National Park - Dynamic Nature of Fire and Ice
description: Vatnajökull National Park covers nearly 14% of Iceland and wraps around Europe's largest glacier, an ice cap about 7,700 square kilometres across. Beneath the ice, eight volcanoes are hidden, and when one erupts, meltwater can burst out in a sudden glacial flood called a jökulhlaup. Over time these floods have carved wide gravel plains, braided rivers and fast-changing canyons.
